descriptions.w3d_s4_card_subscribe_navigation: Subscribes previous, next, and confirm messages once and clears the top status flag.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_unsubscribe_navigation: Unsubscribes and releases the three navigation messages and clears their subscription flag.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_clear_resource: Releases the card resource handle and interface and subtracts ten from the resource count.
